facts.business: Shervani Industrial Syndicate Limited operates primarily in real estate development with a focus on residential and commercial projects, while also pursuing diversification into healthcare through a multi-speciality hospital construction and hospitality via a rural eco-tourism project.
key_risks: Fluctuations in prices of construction materials
Statutory approvals and infrastructure development delays
Macroeconomic factors including inflationary trends and interest rate fluctuations
Volatility in prices of key construction inputs such as steel and cement
